svg.title: NENA Bidirectional Architecture
svg.desc: Two parallel streams: Stream A sign-to-speech outbound, Stream B speech-to-sign inbound, connected by VoIP bridge
svg.text: STREAM A — Outbound: Sign → Speech (Deaf user expresses to caller)
Edge processing on device · Only text tokens sent over network · Stable on 3G
STREAM B — Inbound: Speech → Sign (caller's voice shown to Deaf user)
Edge: sign video processed on-device · only text tokens sent to cloud · works on 3G
